verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a compliance case-management SaaS, so an official CLI is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only HTTP APIs (Alerts, Case, case import, filing), web-UI features and a password-gated developer portal. Nothing describes an official command-line tool, and APIs are developer building blocks rather than a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
